name: Contain + Blur Fill
notes: The house default. Whole photo visible over a blurred, darkened fill of itself.

name: Cover Fill
notes: Photo fills the frame edge to edge; crop bias follows focus point.

name: Dynamic Blur Fill
notes: The blurred fill breathes and counter-pans for depth.

name: Cinema Bars
notes: Letterboxed image between true cinema bars.

name: Polaroid
notes: Instant photo card with a fat bottom edge for captions.

name: Floating Card
notes: Rounded dark card that gently floats over the blur fill.

name: Split Diptych
notes: Two consecutive photos share the frame. Even indices go left.

name: Triptych Stack
notes: Three photos stacked; every third photo leads a new triplet.

name: Corner Collage
notes: Main photo with the next one peeking from a corner. Great for chapter starts.

name: Side Text Panel
notes: Right-side gradient panel reserved for lyrics or dates.

name: Inset Matte
notes: Gallery matte with a hairline gold keyline. Premium and calm.

name: Full-Bleed Tilt
notes: Slightly rotated cover fill; zine-like energy.

name: Filmstrip
notes: Sprocket-hole strips top and bottom. Retro stock feel.

name: Soft Edge
notes: Photo edges feather into the blurred fill. Dreamlike.
